evidence: All 26 descendant primary nodes, including four outcome increments and their gates, are verified. GATE-490 independently repeats inherited scenarios.

The clean development executable carries an embedded SHA-256 ad-hoc signature and launches successfully in UI-smoke mode as an accessory menu-bar utility. Left click, right click, Export Current Evidence, Settings, About, and Quit routes are verified. It is not represented as Developer ID signed or distributable.

Live whole-volume capacity capture, configured watched roots, explicit excluded roots, FSEvents hints, metadata rescans, and registered agent process-tree correlation are implemented with bounded entries, depth, queues, and retention.

Evidence carries path, time, logical/allocated delta, actor/session when supported, method, limitations, causal references, and exact/tool-linked/inferred/unknown confidence. Ambiguous, historical, gapped, and PID-reuse cases do not guess.

Snapshot and evidence-bundle exports contain concise Codex briefs, machine-readable data, privacy declarations, limitations, file byte counts, SHA-256 integrity entries, and deterministic bounded ranges.

The bundled stdio MCP executable serves seven read-only tools over a private app-owned Unix socket. Codex and Claude install/config/session adapters preserve unrelated configuration and query persisted evidence without disk rescans.

Snapshot/FSEvents monitoring remains active without restricted privileges. Exact provenance is accepted only from complete, gap-free privileged fixtures or a future authorized live observer; entitlement absence and permission denial downgrade visibly.

Closed schemas and property tests prohibit file contents and environment data, sensitive metadata is redacted, exclusions and retention are explicit, evidence is preserved on uninstall, and no cleanup/delete mutation or telemetry surface exists.

After a clean, all 105 automated tests pass; the macOS-targeted Xcode scheme builds; the app and MCP executables launch; queue/history/database bounds, overload accounting, unavailable-component recovery, export integrity, and development distribution preflight are reproducible. Signed-release CPU/memory measurements remain a release-stage check.

The implementation performs no deletion, cache purge, process termination, destructive MCP action, cloud sync, account, telemetry, hosted service, cross-platform claim, external-volume deep scan, content read, or entitlement-guarantee claim.

Developer ID distribution, Apple Endpoint Security entitlement approval, production team/app-group identifiers, notarization, live activation, Full Disk Access, upgrade/deactivation, clean-host uninstall, and signed-artifact resource sampling are explicitly documented external release gates.
